# Brits Construction Projects Ltd

> Structural building work and independent project management for residential and commercial projects (extensions, loft conversions, internal alterations, new builds and commercial buildings) in London and the Home Counties. Sister company of Brits Construction Services (https://www.britsconstructionservices.co.uk).

Two core services:
1. Structural works: carrying out the structural building package (demolition, foundations and piling, drainage, brickwork and blockwork, structural steelwork, concrete and beam-and-block floors, screeding, roof structures) to the architect's drawings and structural engineer's design.
2. Project management and independent site oversight: when a homeowner has appointed another builder, we check the work against the drawings, monitor planning conditions and party wall requirements, review progress before stage payments, coordinate the professional team (architects, structural engineers, party wall surveyors) and keep the client informed. Our oversight supports, and does not replace, Building Control and other appointed professionals.
